card.name: Patch altered in any way
card.fires_on: Words right after cut, damaged, changed or alter, such as 'in any way', 'otherwise' or 'altered', where a verb like modify or alter could come next. Mostly in warnings not to use a damaged patch or film.

modes.label: Changed in any way
modes.description: Words 'in' or 'any' in the phrase 'cut, damaged, or changed in any way' in patch and film instructions.
modes.example: Instruct patients not to use BELBUCA if the pouch seal is broken or the buccal film is cut, damaged, or changed in<< any>> way and to avoid applying BELBUCA

modes.label: Alter or modify wording
modes.description: Adverbs or verb forms near 'alter' outside patch labels or in patch wording.
modes.example: The patch must not be<< altered>> (e.g., cut) in any

card.writes: It pushes the model toward words meaning modify or alter.
card.plain: It fires in warnings that a patch or film must not be cut or changed in any way.
